response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, stanza beginning “My child, fear not”","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Not for a second could I leave your side.","suggested_fix":"Replace “צידך” with “לצדך” to correctly say “by your side”: “אפילו לרגע לא עזבתי את לצדך” is not grammatical; use “אפילו לרגע לא עזבתי אותך, ונשארתי לצדך” or, more narrowly, “אפילו לרגע לא משתי לצדך.”","translation_quote":"אפילו לרגע לא עזבתי את צידך."},{"location":"HTML, stanza beginning “But here I have placed My rainbow”","severity":"major","source_quote":"You can see that My promise is certain.","suggested_fix":"Replace “שהבטחתי בטוחה” with “שהבטחתי ודאית” or “שההבטחה שלי ודאית” so the line clearly says that the promise is certain.","translation_quote":"תוכל לראות שהבטחתי בטוחה."}],"passed":false,"score":93}
